minimalPreparation: Create an isolated review-only single-model asset subset for roswaal01 from the audited original JSON/MOC/texture and all referenced motions; include a detail/catalog binding to original files and hashes. Do not install or assign a character to the pending native nodes.

Reuse the designated single Chrome session serially only after root authorization. Load exactly roswaal01 without another actor, using the audited original actor wrapper and a readable whole-model view.

Capture one unoccluded settled full-stage PNG plus raw model canvas PNG; record exact model ID, resource responses/source hashes, original model JSON/MOC/texture identities, and camera/wrapper settings. A neutral display pose is only for costume recognition and does not recover story acting.

Return PNG/index SHA evidence to the named offline image reviewer for direct comparison against both original full-frame witnesses; the root does not view images. Preserve pending if mantle/clothing remains ambiguous.
captureTargets: Entire blue side hair and clown face/eye markings
High red-lined mantle collar and beige neck ruffles
Purple coat with gold trim and visible sleeve/glove shapes
